name: Old Tobin
title: the farmer
greeting: The fields grow nothing but bones these days.
You again? Good. The road needs walking.

requests.title: Rats in the Grain
requests.ask: Plague rats ate what little grain I had. Kill some on the road for me, would you?
requests.done: Ha! That will teach the little devils. Take this, it was my father's.

requests.title: Walk the Far Fields
requests.ask: My son went past the withered fields and never came back. Go further than tile 20 and look for him.
requests.done: Nothing but his hat? ... Thank you for looking. His golden rat followed you back. Keep it, he would want that.

requests.title: A Harvest of Elites
requests.ask: The big ones walk the road like lords. Bring down two elites in a single journey.
requests.done: Two of them! Here, the Reliquary owed me a favour. This blade is yours.

name: Widow Marla
title: who sells at the market
greeting: Fresh bread? No. There is no fresh anything.
My husband rests in the chapel yard. I talk to him sometimes.

requests.title: Warm Fires
requests.ask: Travellers who rest live longer. Rest at three campfires for me (all journeys count).
requests.done: You listened. Not many do. Here, a little stardust from the old shrine.

requests.title: Bend Your Luck
requests.ask: My husband always said fate bends for those who dare. Twist your dice four times.
requests.done: He would have liked you. Take his old lantern-friend, it never liked me anyway.

requests.title: Rest for the Dead
requests.ask: The Bishop keeps the dead from sleeping. Defeat him, and my husband can finally rest.
requests.done: ...He is quiet now. Thank you. A sister of the chapel wants to walk with you.

name: Little Pip
title: who never sleeps
greeting: Are you a real hero? You look tired.
I found a shiny bone! Do you want it? No, it is mine.

requests.title: Strange Stories
requests.ask: Tell me stories! Find three strange things on the road (events count) and come back.
requests.done: A drowned bell?! Wooow. Here, I found these sparkly bits for you.

requests.title: Make Me a Die
requests.ask: Can you carve dice? Carve five times in one journey. I want to learn!
requests.done: So that is how it is done! Look, a lizard that breathes fire followed me home. It likes you more.

requests.title: Brave in the Dark
requests.ask: Mama says nobody comes back from the road at night. Prove her wrong! Finish a journey that starts at night and reach tile 30.
requests.done: You did it! You are the bravest. The funny man with the hat said to give you this.

name: Captain Hesk
title: of the night watch
greeting: Keep your voice down. Things listen at night.
The gate stays shut after dark. Unless you have business.

requests.title: Thin the Ghouls
requests.ask: Ghouls scratch at the gate every night. Destroy eight of them.
requests.done: The scratching stopped. For now. Here, the watch's pay. Do not spend it on drink.

requests.title: The Grave Knight
requests.ask: A knight in rusted armour leads the dead. He was one of mine, once. Put him down.
requests.done: ...Thank you. He was a good man. Take his old partner's blade. It is cursed with moonlight.

requests.title: Into the Curse
requests.ask: You are strong. Strong enough to walk the road under a curse? Win a journey at Curse I or higher.
requests.done: Mad, and alive. The gravedigger wants to work with you. I told him you are trouble. He liked that.
